ranked.headline: Statistical methods for spatial and single-cell omics measurement and inference
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell methods now pair explicit statistical models with benchmarks against established references across diverse measurement types.

ranked.headline: Cohort-robust deep learning for biomedical images and connectivity biomarkers
ranked.summary: Cross-cohort and cross-slide generalization is becoming the evaluation bar for deep learning in biomedical imaging and omics-linked prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of microbial traits from omics and metagenomic data
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and large-scale analyses show no single differential expression method is robust to all confounders, motivating community-level inference frameworks.

ranked.headline: Reusable genomic resources and copy-number-aware inference across diverse lineages
ranked.summary: Larger assembly collections, petabase sequence archives and degraded-DNA pipelines make standardized genomic resources and inference tools broadly usable.

ranked.headline: Graph, tensor, and NMF methods recover spatial organization from omics data
ranked.summary: Structure-imposing computational frameworks are being applied to recover spatial organization in proteomics and transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics links repeats, polyploidy, and structure to genome evolution
ranked.summary: New chromosome-level and phased assemblies across conifers, Vitaceae, notothenioid fish, and Lupinus enable cross-lineage architectural comparison.

ranked.headline: Learned generative models design and optimize molecules for drug discovery
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 work evaluates LLM creativity in molecule generation and applies transformers, GFlowNets, and reinforcement learning to synthesizable molecular design.

ranked.headline: Spatial and metabolic models map cell-state programs in disease and infection
ranked.summary: Spatial omics and metabolic modeling now resolve cell-state coordination, metabolic flux, and causal gene ranking at single-cell and tissue scale.

ranked.headline: Interface-resolved analysis of predicted and experimental protein complex structures
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark and refine AlphaFold models while new tools analyze interfaces in experimental and predicted structures.

ranked.headline: LLM agents and generative models extend molecular identification and drug repurposing
ranked.summary: Agentic and generative models now couple structure generation, literature extraction, and evidence grounding within discovery workflows.

ranked.headline: Deep learning integrates spatial, proteomic, and histology data across omics layers
ranked.summary: Foundation models and graph-based architectures now embed heterogeneous omics, imaging, and clinical data into shared representations.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and new tools reassess single-cell and isoform quantification under ambiguity
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks evaluate single-cell protein imputation, demultiplexing and isoform abundance estimation against direct proxies and existing tools.

ranked.headline: LLM agents autonomously reproduce, ablate, and build biomedical ML pipelines
ranked.summary: Agents now execute multi-stage biomedical analyses, and a 103-task genomics benchmark reports a best pass rate of 33.2%.

ranked.headline: Combined encoders and graph attention drive drug-target and drug-response prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained and graph-attention encoders are being combined across drug-target, synergy, and property tasks, while benchmarks test their added value.

ranked.headline: Machine learning predicts immune recognition: peptide-MHC, TCR, epitope, antibody
ranked.summary: Models that adapt to emerging epitope landscapes and combine structure with language-model embeddings are extending immune recognition prediction.

ranked.headline: Variant effect models extend to protein stability, RNA binding, and recessive disease
ranked.summary: Recent work moves variant interpretation beyond missense frameworks into protein interactomes, RNA-binding interfaces, and regulatory genetics.

ranked.headline: Spatial models link cell arrangement and viral spread to T cell and interferon responses
ranked.summary: Spatially explicit models now connect dendritic cell clustering, within-host dispersal and interferon signalling to immune and viral readouts.

ranked.headline: Physics-based and learned models predicting molecular energies, kinetics and binding
ranked.summary: Recent work couples simulation, learned models and experimental data to improve accuracy of molecular energy and binding predictions.

ranked.headline: Genomic prediction of complex traits extends to rare variants, annotations and GxE
ranked.summary: Recent work pushes polygenic and genomic prediction toward multi-layer inputs, cross-environment transfer, and empirical validity checks of scores.

ranked.headline: Analysis choices in MD govern completeness and fidelity of structural outputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers show that sampling, representation, and metric choices in MD shape how complete and faithful structural outputs are.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings drive RNA, enzyme, and expression prediction
ranked.summary: Benchmarks for sequence-based biomolecular prediction are being stress-tested for leakage and redundancy as embedding-based models expand to new tasks.

ranked.headline: Non-genetic B cell state dynamics accelerate germinal center antibody maturation
ranked.summary: Ground-truth simulators and biologically informed language models are advancing quantitative tests of antibody affinity maturation across scales.

ranked.headline: Reproducibility practices extend from workflow orchestration to metabolic model curation
ranked.summary: Recent preprint and publications address containerized execution, workflow composition, and standardized metabolic model sharing for reproducibility.

ranked.headline: Generalist segmentation models benchmarked on microscopy and spatial-omics data
ranked.summary: Generalist segmentation models are now tested directly on live, spatial-omics, and volumetric data rather than assumed to transfer.

ranked.headline: Perturbation models and benchmarks reshaping therapeutic target nomination
ranked.summary: Preprints and papers now test whether perturbation predictors carry scientific value, while network and digital-twin methods nominate targets.

ranked.headline: Inferring dynamical parameters from single-cell and single-particle trajectory data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and live-cell tracking data now carry trajectory-level information that supports direct inference of dynamical parameters.

ranked.headline: Constraints and latent spaces recover feasible, dynamical metabolic network models
ranked.summary: Teraflux and a generative latent-space method recover feasible fluxes and kinetic models from constraints or learned representations.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and integrative computational frameworks for multi-omic cancer profiling
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and resources reassess multi-omic subtyping and reuse public proteomic and CPTAC data for oncology analysis.

ranked.headline: Reference-based benchmarks probe reliability of automated biological predictors
ranked.summary: Evolving ground truth and distribution shift motivate continuous, split-aware evaluation of automated annotation predictors.

ranked.headline: New software tools for pangenome, recombination, and transcriptome assessment
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers report benchmarked tools for pangenome graphs, recombination detection, and transcriptome and RNA-seq analysis.

ranked.headline: Generative protein and molecular models pairing latent control with geometric evaluation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair generative protein and molecular models with latent steering, inference-time search, and geometric benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Models link single-cell and spatial profiles to donor, species and niche-level biology
ranked.summary: Single-cell and spatial datasets now carry donor, cross-species and subcellular structure that cell-type annotation alone does not capture.

ranked.headline: Pangenome and graph methods expose structural variation missed by linear references
ranked.summary: Phased assemblies, pangenome pipelines, and graph-aware callers are now needed to resolve structural variants that linear references obscure.

ranked.headline: Automated, reproducible workflows packaging established omics and docking analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package docking, metagenomic, cytometry, epigenomic, and RNA-seq analyses into reproducible, interface-driven software.

ranked.headline: Genomic position and cell identity shape design and prediction of regulatory DNA
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a yeast study treat regulatory elements through their genomic setting, from cell-type-specific design to foundation-model representation.

ranked.headline: MD and smFRET-restrained ensembles resolve state-specific conformational landscapes
ranked.summary: Atomistic ensembles and free energy landscapes now resolve disordered and autoinhibited states beyond static structures.

ranked.headline: Parameterized models dissect mechanical and informational drivers of tissue behavior
ranked.summary: Recent models isolate specific force terms and order measures and test them against tissue-scale outcomes in epithelia, migration, and embryos.

ranked.headline: Verifiable FDR reporting and workflow choice shape proteomics identification results
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and diagnostics now test whether proteomics software and FDR reporting yield reproducible, verifiable results.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models design codon sequences, UTRs, and functional RNAs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple secondary-structure free energies, 3D protein structure, and language models to design coding and regulatory sequences.

ranked.headline: Computational pipelines design receptor-selective binders and predict CAR cell responses
ranked.summary: Closed-loop optimization, AlphaFold-Multimer screening, and conditional optimal transport now yield testable predictions for receptor-targeted design.
